description.zh: 被抵扣实例的ID，为空时返回所有实例的明细数据。
description.en: The ID of the instance whose fees are deducted by using the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all instances are queried.
The time when the RI expires. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.
The instance type of the RI.
The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页条数，默认为20，最大值为300。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

description.zh:
取值：
- ecsRi（默认值）：ECS的预留实例。
- scu_bag：存储容量单位包。
description.en:
The code of the service to which the RI is applied. Default value: ecsRi. Valid values:

*   ecsRi: ECS RI.
*   scu_bag: storage capacity unit (SCU).

description.zh: 筛选查询的预留实例ID，为空时返回所有的使用的预留实例明细。
description.en: The ID of the RI. If this parameter is left empty, the usage details of all RIs are queried.
The time when the RI was created. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi query-ri-utilization-detail --ri-instance-id dsudfgdsjh --instance-spec Instancetyp --ri-commodity-code ecsRi --deducted-instance-id jsdgfsdhgsdjh --start-time 2019-05-23_12:00:00 --end-time 2019-05-23_12:00:00 --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
